headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Close public testimony on BFED 1 and accept written testimony
meeting.summary: The budget committee reviewed Environmental Management's proposed 13.5% budget increase, including a 9% average sewer rate increase, and closed public testimony.
meeting.recap: The only agenda item was the proposed fiscal year 2027 County budget.[[0:02:47]] A member said 28 people testified at the South Maui budget meeting.[[0:03:30]] A member said 10 people testified at the Lānaʻi budget meeting on April 15th.[[0:07:03]] The department proposed a 9% average sewer rate increase, about $2.2 million in new revenue.[[0:19:11]] Monthly trash pickup fees on Maui and Molokaʻi would rise from $36 to $37.[[0:20:03]] A Haʻikū testifier said the water department will not drill a deep monitoring well.[[1:19:15]] The committee closed public testimony with no objections.[[1:46:51]] The director said some vacant positions are used to cover overtime costs.[[2:06:49]] The director said Army Corps fees covered moving fire debris to the landfill.[[2:14:27]] Staff said a budget priority survey has 215 responses so far.[[2:57:29]] The meeting adjourned.[[3:11:48]]
decided: The committee closed public testimony with no objections.
meeting.next: Staff will give members a final budget survey report at the start of decisions week. The department will follow up in writing on a question about fringe benefit requests.

moments.q: Vice chair explains asking to preside over this meeting
Members begin questions for the department
